observations: Hero and top show one S-curved positive trilobed ridge; center broader and taller than outer ridges, two narrow grooves; thick irregular slab. Side confirms positive relief.
contradictions: Concept is much more photorealistic/texture-heavy than low-poly brief. Side is an illustrative transverse view, not exact orthographic or dimensional proof. Resolve with simple original faceting and no textures; retain proportions and positive polarity.
hidden_surfaces: Flat closed underside; continuous integral slab and height-field relief, no inferred animal or lower trace anatomy.
